tool.name: Temporal
tool.description: Durable execution platform that makes agent loops and workflows survive crashes, timeouts and multi-day human approvals.
strengths: OpenAI Agents SDK, Pydantic AI, ADK integrations
Self-host MIT server or Temporal Cloud
tool.pricing: Temporal Cloud pay-as-you-go from $50 per million actions (volume discounts to $25), plus storage; $150 trial credits for 90 days.
tool.practitionerNote: Use when agents must run for hours or days, pause for approvals, and resume exactly after failures; it adds a workflow-determinism discipline teams must learn. In the OpenAI Agents SDK integration, sandbox support is pre-release and streaming is experimental.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Self-hosted server runs anywhere; Temporal Cloud lets customers pick AWS or GCP regions per namespace, with multi-region replication.

deployment.detail: MIT server for self-hosting, or managed Temporal Cloud SaaS.

auditLogging.detail: Temporal Cloud audit logs cover control-plane events only (users, API keys, namespaces); data-plane events need Export.

soc2.detail: Temporal Cloud is SOC 2 Type II certified; not applicable to self-hosted OSS.

iso27001.detail: Not listed on Temporal's security page or Trust Center (SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA shown).

iso42001.detail: No ISO 42001 certification listed on Temporal's security page or Trust Center.

euAiAct.detail: Workflow orchestration infrastructure, not an AI system placed on the market; obligations rest with the deployer.

licenseRisk.detail: MIT server — permissive, OSI-approved; Temporal Cloud is proprietary SaaS.
